# Xomtra

> Xomtra keeps years of your Home Assistant history, finds patterns and anomalies, and lets Claude or any MCP client answer questions about your home. Read-only, running on your own hardware.

Xomtra is an independent open source project (Apache 2.0) for Home Assistant. It is not affiliated with the Open Home Foundation or Nabu Casa.

Status: public beta coming soon. Contact support@xomtra.com to be notified.

## What it does

- **Years of history:** States and statistics kept for months or years in compressed Parquet files, without loading the Home Assistant database.
- **Findings every day:** Entity catalog, data quality checks, correlations between devices and anomalies, ready before you ask.
- **Safe by design:** AI can read, never switch anything. Roles for family members, and every query is logged.

## Compared with the built-in Home Assistant MCP server

| | Built-in HA MCP server | Xomtra |
|---|---|---|
| History | Recorder window (typically 10 days) | Months to years |
| Analysis | Raw data only | Correlations, anomalies, weekly summary |
| Can control devices | Yes (admin) | No, read-only |
| Roles and audit | Admins only | Reader / Admin, full audit log |
| Load on Home Assistant | Queries hit the HA database | Separate storage |

## Install

- **Home Assistant add-on:** For Home Assistant OS on an SSD with 4 GB RAM or more.
- **Proxmox VE:** Ready virtual machine, created by one command on the host.
- **VMware:** OVA appliance for ESXi, vSphere or Workstation.
- **Docker Compose:** For your own Linux server or NAS.

## Get started

1. **Install:** Add-on, Proxmox, VMware or Docker. No domain, no port forwarding, no cloud account.
2. **Connect:** Create a token on the admin page and add Xomtra to Claude Desktop with one file.
3. **Ask:** History imports in the background. Ask your first question right away.

## Example questions

- Which devices use power at night when nobody is home?
- Has the bedroom humidity changed since we got the new windows?
- How much did the solar panels cover of last month's consumption?
- Which sensors stopped reporting this week?

## FAQ

### Do I need Claude?

No. Xomtra works with Claude Desktop, Claude.ai and any client that speaks MCP. Your AI subscription is your own; Xomtra never pays or sees it.

### Does my data leave the house?

Only the answers your AI client asks for, under your account. Xomtra itself sends nothing anywhere unless you turn on anonymous install counting.

### How much disk does it need?

A typical home needs 2–5 GB for 90 days of states and 5 years of hourly statistics. Large setups with years of states should use the Proxmox or VMware appliance.

### Is it affiliated with Home Assistant?

No. Xomtra is an independent open source project built for Home Assistant.
